question: what is vi order

The responsibility for the latter lies within the provider of the “virtual interlining” fare. question: how to handle tech alerts in schedule change
ground_truth: Tech Alerts As many of you may know, when an airline changes something in the PNR, we get a notification in our system. For example, schedule change notification (UN/TK) or when the airline exchanges a ticket. However, we do have cases where there is a technical error in the airline's system, and they have to notify us of a change they have had while the aircraft were still in operation. For such cases, the airline provides us with a special policy for a specific route and date that we must follow. In the need to inform all parties involved of such errors a new category (Attribute) has been created in the Edvin Documents/Schedule Change tab, that will include the proper airline policy to follow. Until now, the schedule change agent had to check the flight status in GDS to identify the schedule change and inform the passenger about the possible alternatives, based on the Edvin Documents for SC Policies. Now having in mind the possibility of a technical error, we should follow the below: 1. Open order in Edvin. 2. Open PNR in GDS and check flight status and flight number. 3. Open the Edvin Docs, first checking whether there is a new technical error under the attribute ‘Tech Alert’ that affects that specific flight in the PNR for the specific period mentioned. 3.1. If this is indeed a ‘Tech Alert’ please follow the instructions of that category and not the normal SC policy. 3.2. If the flight details do not match with the ‘Tech Alert’ information, please proceed with any alternatives that can be provided as per the Schedule Change policy or Covid-19. The information will be shared: 1. With the SC team through an email. 2. Through Edvin Documents in SC tab. 3. Through Shelf- SC folder- Tech Alerts. ATTENTION: In case the instructions are not followed, ADMs will be issued from the airline(s)

question: how ryanair pnrs are sold through bingtrip
ground_truth: Ryanair PNRs sold through BingTrip Ryanair does not provide support to travel agencies. Agents can never contact Ryanair - not by phone, chat, email or in any way and not even on behalf of the customer. If you cannot handle it on the airline's website, refer them to contact Ryanair directly. For our cooperation with BingTrip, it has been decided that we will sell Ryanair and handle it as per our normal routines for LCC and Special handling LCC, except for the cases where voluntary and involuntary refund has been requested. question: what are the steps for name correction or name change
ground_truth: Name correction/Name change Please see the rules per airline in Edvin documents if name correction is allowed, please read the section in Edvin for name correction thoroughly before following the below steps. A passport copy is always needed before contacting the airline. When collecting payment from customers the airline name fee must always be collected through the payment link using the: Airline Cost -Name Change Name correction in Farelogix: Split out the passenger with the wrong name, don't forget to link pnr in Edvin. See the split section in Shelf. Create a new PNR with the correct name as shown in Pass/ID with the exact same travel itinerary details. Book the same booking class as the original. If it's not available, then select any other available booking class in the same cabin except N, X, J, and O and contact the airline company. 1. Click on Add air: 2. 3. Choose the same itinerary and booking class as the original booking, if the same class is not available choose the next higher available. Add them to the shopping cart. 4. Add the new correct name, telephone number, and email by clicking on the + next to each tab 5. Click on Price to check the price of the new ticket's pricing, while the FL agent needs to calculate if there is any fare/tax difference (by checking the old ticket/pricing). Important notice: The time limit will appear in the reservation as an SSR element. Send the new PNR along with the necessary documents and the old ''wrong'' ticket number of the passenger to the airline's helpdesk for authorization and to reinstate the original booking class if needed. When the authorization is granted and the airline has reinstated the original booking class (if needed), price the itinerary in the NEW pnr to make sure that the price value of the same booking class has not been changed. If there is a fare/tax difference charge the customer before continuing. Please do not wait too long as A3/OA has very short time limits on their tickets. In case the new fare is higher due to fare recalculation, the agent must charge the name correction fee plus the difference between the original and the current value (without rebooking fee). In case the new fare is lower, the agent must book a higher RBD so that the new fare is equal or higher (regardless of RBD) and then charge the name correction fee plus the fare difference between the original and the new RBD (without rebooking fee). The form of payment in Farelogix for OA/A3 is always VCC/VAN. You need to create a virtual van in Edvin to pay for the name correction: Product - Airline cost, Flexible ticket or Rebooking (splitted PNR). Choose line with correct PNR for your reissue. Amount - Total cost of reissue, for all pax. Ex. reissue cost is 30EUR per pax and PNR has 3 pax, amount to be added is 90EUR Currency - Issuing currency. Example flexible ticket without fare diff charged. (Manual) means flexible ticket purchased over phone and we can choose either product, it does not matter. Click on Create card and a VAN card has now been created for your amount. Click on Show Copy View Copy the card number and expiration date. You can use the copy to clipboard button or just mark the numbers and copy. question: what is disconnected chat guidelines
ground_truth: Disconnected chat guidelines Guidelines are to be followed in case a customer or agent has disconnected the chat interaction. Most common applicable scenarios. 1.Customers who wait in the queue to get connected to an agent on chat but end up leaving the chat. 2.Customer being unresponsive due to the long wait. 3.Agent disconnected the chat by mistake or due to a technical error. Always use the channel ‘’chat’’ for registering errands. Do not forget to include the conversation id. Important Note: The agents are expected to always follow the FCR in every process which ends when the agents communicate the actions taken toward the customer's request. Therefore, when applicable, the standard template needs to be amended. The customer shall not be motivated/encouraged to contact us again when not really necessary. If the agent has provided the requested information and the passenger replies after the message with any text (meaning he/she received the message ) there is no need to send the email template. Always remember to send the applicable scripts for idle/closing as stated in this link <<https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/955db5c0-9d8a-4049-adf4-7f0f33b99f65?view=dashboard&trigger=double-click&component=recently-added&source=shelf&DTStep=vXk76QUACD>> before you proceed with disconnecting the chat. All email templates for disconnected chat scenarios can be found in Edvin in the folder First Line-> Chat and Booking.com->First Line-> Chat Templates are available in English and in local languages based on the market. 1. Send the email in English. 2.If a customer from a non-English market contacts us in a language other than English and the original market language, send the email in the original market language. 2.1 Example: A customer from the IT Italian market contacts us in French on chat. question: what is the difference between schedule change and force majeure
ground_truth: Schedule change is a general policy provided by the airline for involuntary handling scenarios. On the other hand, for Force Majeure scenario airline's provide exceptional policies and guidelines due to extraordinary events, based on certain criteria, such as travel date or route. In the event of a flight change due to an airline notification or an extraordinary event occurring as mentioned by the customer, the agent should review Edvin Document with the following order to determine the appropriate policy: a) Covid19 b) FM / Travel Alerts c) Tech Error d) Schedule change
context: Basic Information / Good to know What is Schedule change (SC)? Any modification to the flight schedule before the departure date due to the airline's operational reasons. Examples: 1) Change of time schedule, flight number 2) Misconnection 3) Additional stop 4) Airport change What is Force Majeure (FM)? Unforeseeable circumstances that prevent the airline from operating the flight Examples: 1) Epidemic/Pandemic(COVID-19) 2) Damage to the infrastructure due to an extraordinary situation(Blast in Beirut) 3) Natural disaster(Tsunami, Typhoon, Earthquake, etc) 4) Strike 5) Bankruptcy 6) Air traffic congestion For more information please click here .<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/2662b801-e287-4fda-927f-c5b701210ec3/?parentId=adbc99b0-7e16-4195-9749-b61a27c59c96&searchEventId=01HVV38JWS5EZTRMYFB52RXJWX&source=shelf&trigger=title&view=list-view >> Difference between schedule change and force majeure Schedule change is a general policy provided by the airline for involuntary handling scenarios. question: how to add baggage and other ancillaries
ground_truth: Content - Amadeus GDS Entries How to add Baggage and other Ancillaries Jump to correct office ID, just click on the office ID. To open pnr: RTPNR Then open the catalog by using this command: FXK From here you can choose what type of ancillaries you want to add. Example for baggage:Click on the little box beside the price on the ancillary you want to add. Make sure its possible to be added for all the wanted segments. And then click on ‘’Book and Price’’: After that your request will be added as an SSR element. You must check if the ancillary is turning HK before you charge the customer. Retrieve the SSR lines with command RTG. If the ancillary service is pending with HN status, save with ER and refresh the PNR with IR. To remove the SSR request: If the customer does not pay, remove the SSR request with command XEx where x is the line of the SSR, e.g. XE15 for removing line 15 from the PNR. Every action should be saved in the end with ER

question: how to add osi & ssr

question: how to add passport information and frequent flyer
ground_truth: Content - Amadeus GDS Entries How to add Passport Information and Frequent Flyer (APIS/DOCS & FF) We can add APIS and DOCS manually and graphically. To add them graphically click on ‘’Your Smart Flows’’ and select→ ‘’APIS’’ to add the Passeport Information ‘’DOCS’’ to add only the DOB information.You can insert manually the same information as per below commands: Passport Information→ SRDOCSYY HK1-(document type)-(document issue country) (document number)-(document nationality country)-(date of birth:DDMMMYY)-(gender)-(document expiration date:DDMMMYY)-(last name)-(first name)/paxnumber For example: SRDOCS YY HK1-P-GRC-AT2120405-GRC-03DEC94-F-04JUL26-SURNAME-FIRSTNAME/P1 Every action should be saved in the end with ER.DOB Information→ SRDOCS YYHK1-(date of birth:DDMMMYY)-(gender)-surname-firstname/P1 For example: SRDOCS YY HK1-----03DEC94-f--surname-firstname/P1 Every action should be saved in the end with ER. To add the Frequent Flier Number use the below command: FFN YY-xxxxxxxxx/P1 (where YY is the 2 letter airline code and x is the FF number) Every action should be saved in the end with ER.

question: how to check fare rules with smartflow power scripts
ground_truth: How to check fare rules with Smartflow Power scripts This Powerscript will help to find the accurate fare rules for rebooking and cancellation. 1. Once you retrieve the PNR in order to check the fare rules rebooking or cancellation, we will use Fare Rule Powerscript, Ensure that you are in the ticketing office ID. 2. Under Smart-Flows, need to select Fare Rule Powerscript. 3. The list of ETG products such as Flexible Ticket, Seating and Cabin will be displayed and the GK line will be automatically added to the PNR. PLEASE NOTE: ETG cancelation products such as CGE and CFAR as not listed here 4. The section 1 will indicate if the ticket is under Void as per BSP condition i.e. if it's on the same day. 5. Section 2 here you can view the fare family and enter the fare family name in the box. 6. Section 3 here can click the previous page option to check Fare Family if not visible on the current page. 7. We may come across rare scenarios where the Right side will show blank when asking for a Fare family. Under such situations kindly enter NA and continue. 8. After comparing the fare basis, input the number linked to the fare basis. PLEASE NOTE: If there's a Single Fare display, as shown in the screenshot, enter 1. 9.1 Check the number of Fare components 9.2 Also you will be able to check the number of Pricing Unit IMPORTANT: If you do not see such a display, please check the fare on STO PCC to determine if the Fare component or Pricing unit is shown. If the display does not appear in STO, it indicates that the ticket has only one FC(Fare Component) and PU (Pricing Unit). 10. If you want to see more fare rules, type Y. If not, just type N to continue and fare rules will be displayed. 10.1 If you enter “Y”; the list of fare rules will be displayed which can be selected for E.g. Maximum Stay, Flight Application etc. 10.2 If you enter “N”; the list of checks will be displayed as a reminder to make sure nothing is left out

question: how to check fare rules
ground_truth: Content - Amadeus GDS Entries How to check fare rules 1st option: the FQP smartflow Insert the ticket number and then the number of the flight coupons. Select the respective option with FQQ number of options (Eg: FQQ4) If needed(if more than one option in result). Make sure all the fare bases in the selected option match the ones in your ticket. Check the rules with FQN number of option*PE(Eg: FQN1*PE) *Does not work for OPEN JAW tickets (ARN-ATH / ROM-ARN) Option 2: Backdate Pricing (FXX command) If we have active segments in the PNR, price them with the date of the ticket issuance: FXX/S2-3,5-6/R,UP,20MAR22 FXX: is pricing command S: are the segments numbers 20MAR22: date of ticket issuance Select the respective option with FQQ number of options (Eg: FQQ4) If needed(if more than one option in result). Make sure all the fare bases in the selected option match the ones in your ticket. FQQ number of option(Eg: FQQ2) FQNnumber of option*PE(Eg: FQN2*PE) Option 3: FQD Command FQDCDGATH/R,UP,20MAR22/D15JUN22/AAF/CK FQD CDGATH: is the city pair (origin and destination of the fare component) 20MAR22: date of ticket issuance. 15JUN22: date of departure(for this city pair destination) AAF: A is constant and AF is the 2 letter airline code (e.g AF→ Air France) CK: C is constant and K is the booking class/first letter of the fare basis After, use the command FQN1*PE to read the penalties where 1 is the option of the correct fare basis. What if there is the same fare basis more than once? Then,you will have to select the fare base where the fare amount is the same as in the original ticket. Please compare the ticket’s fare amount with the fare amount that you see beside the fare basis.
context: How to check fare rules General: If a ticket was exchanged, usually you need to check the original ticket and insert the original ticket issue date in your command. Guidelines on how to check which cancellation rules will apply for reissued tickets can be found here <<https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/2dd08be8-e876-463b-ad3b-07e13bdd2f33?parentId=fa27987a-15d6-437c-8d79-4df8051f804b&view=card-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=01GF5HTEP38EXC4AJSK5P2RXNR&source=shelf>>. We need always to identify first the number of the pricing units and fare components, to understand the penalty application. For more information, please check this page <<https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/b76bc541-b4c2-4da6-a89e-3cc19e8a4f5c?parentId=d9fe540b-7c96-4903-a0bd-1791051452cc&view=snippet-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=01H4R7R368Q90N8G1E5YN3EHTG&source=shelf>>. If there is more than one pricing unit in the ticket, but in the fare rules it is not mentioned to apply the penalty per pricing unit, by default, we apply the penalties per each PU as a sum. Option 1: the FQP smart fl Insert the ticket number and then the number of the flight coupons: Select the respective option with FQQ number of options (Eg: FQQ4) If needed (if more than one option is in the result). Make sure all the fare bases in the selected option match the ones in your ticket. Check the rules with FQN number of option*PE(Eg: FQN1*PE) *Does not work for OPEN JAW tickets (ARN-ATH / ROM-ARN) Once you locate the name of the fare family used, retrieve the FQP smart-flow command that was done earlier and add to its end the fare family qualifier: /FF-name For example: /FF-COMFORTFLE fqpCDG/aA3/cM/d08AUGATH/aA3/cM/d08AUGKGS/aA3/cB/d20AUGATH/aA3/cB/d20AUGCDG/r,30MAY23, up/FF-COMFORTFLE It does not work for OPEN JAW tickets. question: what are the steps to add chargeable seating
ground_truth: Chargeable seating - Sabre 1) Check the possibility to add seating manually in GDS. Use the command 4G1*, where 1 is the desired segment number. Alternatively, you may add the seats also by graphical mode. Press on the luggage icon and then on the three dots icon under Air category. Choose Seats. 2) The seatmap will be shown. 2.1) Once you choose the desired seat, its number will be added near the passenger’s name, under each seat number, you will see the cost per selected seat, while at the bottom you will see the total. 2.2) Press Save to add the request to the PNR. 2.3) Close the seat map and save with 6 your initials and ER. 3) Use *AE to check the status of the seating request added to the PNR. The status has to be “HD – PAYMENT REQUIRED”. If the status is correct save the PNR with 6 your initials + ER. If you see status HN, try to save the PNR with 6 your initials + ER, refresh it and open once again the pricing mask with *AE. If the status is still HN, it is not possible to issue the EMD. By using *AES you can check the time limit for the seating EMD issuance. You may use also *B to check that the chargeable SSR has been successfully added to the PNR and its status is HK. 4) The price shown in ancillary services pricing mask (*AE) is per person and per flight segment. You may find more flights if you MD (Move down). 4.1) In order to calculate the total cost for the passenger, take the airline cost and multiply it by correct mark-up (check the correct markup in the main menu, << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/84d4ff08-daf7-4c11-a927-2d4b516ec19f?parentId=e4d629d2-0b82-4eab-a221-c0593b23c87d&view=card-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=409079a9-4d44-4590-8fcf-d87e6a876969&source=shelf >> in point 1) Ancillaries and Services List) 4.2) Multiply the amount by the number of segments (always check if there is different cost for any of the selected seats). 4.3) Multiply the amount once again by the number of passengers 5) Create Add on cart and process the payment as per standard routines. 6) Once the payment is fulfilled follow the standard EMD ancillaries steps for Edvin - add an Errand with relevant template to the ticketing and queue the order to Ticketing for EMD issuance. For more detailed guidelines you may check here << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/84d4ff08-daf7-4c11-a927-2d4b516ec19f/?parentId=e4d629d2-0b82-4eab-a221-c0593b23c87d&view=card-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=85c16d21-d128-4082-b151-daa736d18a3d&source=shelf >> in section 2) How to add ancillaries. 6.1) If the customer will not finalize the payment on the spot, you may send a Payment Link as per standard routines and then the Support agent will add the Ticketing template and will place the order on the Ticketing queue. Do not remove seating from the PNR in such a scenario. For more detailed guidelines you may check the main menu,<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/84d4ff08-daf7-4c11-a927-2d4b516ec19f/?parentId=e4d629d2-0b82-4eab-a221-c0593b23c87d&view=card-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=85c16d21-d128-4082-b151-daa736d18a3d&source=shelf >> in point 2) How to add ancillaries If the customer will not pay the payment link on the spot, the Support agent will add the Ticketing template and will place the order on the Ticketing queue. question: how to apply request to avia api for invl refund or reissue
ground_truth: How to apply request to Avia Api for invl refund or reissue Below process only applies if you see the Avia center banner and Tripstack logo in the Edvin order. In those cases, customer contact us directly, FL agent handles most claims by contacting Avia center support. We are never allowed to contact the carriers as Avia center is a consolidator. question: what are steps for name correction
ground_truth: Azul Airlines (AD) Name correction Name correction step-by step: General guidelines: 1) Name correction is possible for changes up to 4 characters without any cost. 2) Name correction is possible only 1 time, so make sure that the customer has provided his passport and the new name is correct. 1) Login to the portal, using your personal credentials. 2) Translate your page into English, using right click and selecting Translate into English. Do not forget that in every page you move on you need to translate. 3) Once the page has been translated, click on Consult reservations and add the PNR and the passenger's surname as they appear in Edvin. Search for reservations made will always have by default selected the option by the agency, do not try to change it. Click on Consult to move on the next page. 4) After the PNR is retrieved within the portal, click on the pencil on the right, in order to be able to modify the PNR. 5) Review the details of the page and move down until you find the Passenger information field. Click on pencil icon next to the name to proceed with the name correction. 6) Select what part of the name needs to be updated and click on To save. If the payment is not completed yet, you may click on To go back

question: what are the steps to void consolid for backoffice portal
ground_truth: Backoffice portal - how to void All refund claims must be handled by Frontline. The only refund that can be made through Consolids BO portal is VOID (Same date as ticket issuance), For other cancellation/refund please check the tab for Consolid Support portal. If customer calls and wants to void their ticket. FL agent: Inform customer about our cancellation policy as per usual routine, and that booking will be placed on support. No guarantee of refund. If void is successful support agent will send cancellation confirmation to pax. FL agent place the booking on urgent support queue. (send slack or escalate to SOD depending on what office you belong to as void needs to handle asap.) FL Support: log in to the Consolid BO portal << https://consolid.webtravelcaster.com/bo/Default.aspx >> to search for your booking click on Bookings: Remember to change the start booking date and insert pnr in the highlighted field under Booking number and click on search. the booking number for Consolid can only be found through the Tripstack portal. << https://portal.production.tripstack.com/bookings >> The pnr that we see in Edvin does not work in Consolids BO portal as it is the airlines own reference. You can try to search for the passenger surname instead and change the start booking date and the booking should be visible below. If it does not work to open booking with passenger surname in Consolids portal you need to retreive Consolids own booking number- log in to the Tripstack portal, search for the booking with passenger surname or airline locator. Click on the booking ID Copy the agency reference and go bak to the Consolid BO portal and insert the reference in the booking number field. To Void the booking: When you have searched for your booking in the BO portal by booking number or surname. Click on the pen to open it. To check if void is possible, you can see at the bottom of the page after you have retrieved the booking. Due to a recent update now we have the possibility to see more details. Also, in order to be able to confirm the time shown, the portal has been updated and it can show the time both in ARG and on the user's time. If void is possible, the red Cancel booking button should be shown in the booking order view: You can void the booking from the order view (booking order view is on the first start page, where you search for the booking/pnr): or by clicking on the Cancel button. Fill in the cancellation reason void - full refund. The ticket status in the booking order view (booking order view is where you search for the booking/pnr), has to change to: Status has to change to: Only when ticket has changed to Cancelled/expired we can confirm the void to the customer. If you see this message, your void is not completed and you must contact Consolid support << https://support.consolidglobal.com/tickets.php >> to void the ticket: Sometimes it can take time for the void to be confirmed, as long as we have performed the void request from our end Consolid will handle it from their end. Only when you see that the ticket status has changed to cancelled/expired/voided you can continue with the next steps and send confirmation to the customer. If the status hasn't changed to voided, try logging out from the BO portal and then log in after a couple of minutes. If the void status is still request cancellation and the void period is getting out of reach, contact Consolid through the Consolid Support portal. (please see instructions in this same Shelf folder above this one.) When the void status is cancelled/expired, Void is confirmed in the BO portal: Copy the void confirmation message from the Consolid backoffice portal in the booking history tab, go to Edvin Modify order, and add the copied text in your register errand in modify order : Send a cancellation confirmation email to the passenger from Edvin.

question: how to handle customer requests for support portal
ground_truth: Support portal - How to handle customer requests All support cases: We can handle all rebookings, ancillaries, wheelchair assistance, name corrections etc. We are NOT allowed in any case to contact the airline. If support is needed FL agent can contact Consolid support through the process down below. Consolid's Support portal: https://consolidglobal.zendesk.com/hc/en-us. When you have to contact Consolid in the Support portal: Support is open between 9.30 am GMT-3 - midnight (local Argentinian time) . Through this portal we can request: Rebooking, refund, name correction inquires, wheelchair assistance etc. How yo create a ticket (request) through Zendesk: You should log-in using the information here<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/05238cc8-7c1a-4f82-a21d-dd5bb8d214a0?parentId=56c4c115-3f10-4c58-8190-4fbbd5f45a50&view=snippet-view&trigger=double-click&searchEventId=01GEKFMGDX1HPGSGQ49AQQT5NX&source=shelf&DTStep=b_ku6jlL7U >> and click on ‘Submit a request’. You'll be requested to log in in the system: Once you're logged-in, you should select the topic to receive our support accordingly: Once you fill all the mandatory fields, you should click on submit: This will create a case for you: And it will send an email as well: Please ALWAYS remember to use Consolid's reference when opening a request and not ours or the airline's. Otherwise you can follow the below: 1) Go to Booking History tab, where you are able to create new cases. 2) On the bottom of the page you will see mention of ‘ New case of type’ and you should select the type of case that you need to create. 3) The system will redirect you to Zendesk with the booking details prefilled (you have to be already logged-in in Zendesk. Otherwise, it will require to you to log in and won't recover the booking details): 4) After the ticket is created, it will display the following screen: And it will send an email as well: How to reply to an open case: To answer a case, you can reply to the email sent by the system or you can add a comment in the case once you're logged-in. When you're logged-in, you can manage the cases submit by your organization as well. Click on your name in the right upper side of the screen and click on 'Requests': All the cases will be displayed and you can filter by the status as well: You can list all the cases created for a specific booking in the Booking history section of our Back Office: To reply to a ticket from the Back Office, you can be redirected to Zendesk clicking on the icon of the pencil. Cases statuses: Open: when our team is working on the case Awaiting your reply: when we need your reply in order to proceed. Please note that you have 48hs to reply to the case. After that, the case will be automatically changed to "solved" status. Solved: when no further action should be needed. You'll have 7 days to reopen the ticket in case that you need further help. After a day, you should create a follow-up ticket. ATTENTION: Once 7 days have passed after the ticket was solved, you won't be able to reopen it. For this reason, you can create a follow-up case:

question: steps for new ticket sell
ground_truth: Travelfusion - New ticket sell The below guidelines refer only to Travelfusion bookings. ***ATTENTION*** You should not offer a new ticket sell to the customer. The below process can be used only in case of flexible ticket service or authorization by your manager. Log in to the TravelFusion IBE portal here <<https://ibe.travelfusion.com/flight>>. 2. Click on Flight Search. 3. Insert the flight details you wish to book and click on Search: ***Note: Change the currency to the customer's currency. If the customer's currency is not available in the list, select EUR: 4. After the customer has completed the payment, issue a VAN card and complete the below fields on the same page: 7.1 At the top of the page, you insert the passenger's details. ***ATTENTION*** Age is a mandatory field for all passengers. Make sure to request it from the Customer before proceeding with a new ticket. 7.2. Right after is the seating map. Below the seating map you should fill in the credential account from Edvin docs: It is important to add the credentials, otherwise, we will not be able to access the booking on EasyJet's website. 7.3 Below the account credentials, insert the customer's contact information: 7.4 The final fields are the Billing information. Insert the VAN card details and click on Next: Then follow the next steps to get to the confirmation page. Once the new booking is created, link PNR in Edvin.

question: how to do name correction or name change
ground_truth: Name correction/Name change For Tripstack bookings: Agents can NEVER contact EasyJet - not by phone, chat, email, or in any way and not even on behalf of thecustomer. Please refer the customers to the airline company directly, only in case it is needed. 1. On the easyJet.com homepage, click on ‘Manage bookings’ and log in with the credentials from Edvin documents and the PNR from Edvin. 2. Click on Change names Please note that if you change a passenger’s name, it will be changed on all flights associated with the passenger. So for example, where we have a return flight, the passenger’s name will be changed on the outbound and the inbound flights. 3. On the next page, you will be able to see the name correction fee at the top of the page. The cost is per passenger per flight. 4. Scroll down, select the passenger you want to update/change the name. Update/Change the name and then Click on Continue. You may update more than one customer at this step. **Keep in mind that in this way you may also add an infant to the booking. Click on Add infant to booking, insert the name/surname and select the passenger the infant should be attached to. 5. On the next page, you will be able to see the total cost of the name correction/change. At this stage, you should charge the customer. 6. Once the customer pays, issue a VAN card and proceed with the payment. ***ATTENTION*** In order to proceed with the payment, you need to click on the checkbox, confirming the Terms and conditions, and also insert the password from Edvin docs in the field Member account password, before clicking on PAY NOW

question: cancelation under cancellation guarantee
ground_truth: cancellation Guarantee - FL actions As of January 2021 - this product is now live in more than 40+ markets. It is therefore crucial that the agents are checking the correct procedure for the product. It is very important that all agents are fully up and running with this product and how to identify and handle these cancellations, as the normal cancellation protection will still be valid for other markets. What does the confirmation look like for the customer? Phone/Email Agent Process to follow: Customer Calls/emails for a cancellation using the CXL product. - Check Edvin's overview to ensure that the CXL guarantee product has been purchased. Please note that when the product was released it was listed under various names. Product's name per market can be found here. However, on September 9, 2021 the product name is unified and translated according to the market being sold. - If the above is true, you should confirm the cancellation of the whole order for all passengers or for a split customers. - Inform about the conditions (No fee is charged). The customer will receive a voucher worth 90% of the flight value. - Continue with the cancellation of flight segments in GDS / If LCC cancel the order for the ones you are allowed to do that. - Cancel the booking by using the "Modify order" and not the "cancel button". Please follow the below steps: STEP 1 STEP 2 Select the respective passenger and the segments of the booking. - As soon as you complete all the necessary steps, the order will end up in the Refund Dashboard. * If it is an IAG booking see routine on the chapter No 3<< https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/b6bde260-74f0-43fc-a886-8e26ad2de43c >> ** For Farelogix bookings as the cancellation is completed by FL, the FL agents have to leave a note with the refundable amount in order to take it consideration the SL agents when they close the order in Antares. STEP 3 - Proceed with sending a cancellation confirmation email to the customer. New templates are available and to be used for this specific product. Choose either full or split cancellation confirmation: Please keep in mind that no fee is charged for the cancellation against the CXL guarantee. STEP 4 Place the order to the CXL guarantee queue because the voucher is issued by the Support team. The support agent will pick up the order and create a voucher worth 90% of the airline ticket. As soon as the voucher is created, an email is sent automatically to customer stating the voucher code. This email is also displayed in the errand notes. How does the system calculate 90% of the ticket value? Example: Air product is 200 EUR / Agent calculate 200*0.9 =180 EUR If Multi PNR then calculate all Air products If only 1 of 2 passengers are cancelled: 200 EUR/2 =100*0.9 = 90 EUR. The voucher's validity is 12 months from the date of issuance NOTE: In case the customer is not eligble for the CXL Guarantee, you can send the email with subject " CXL Guarantee denied" ( First Line --> Cancellation--> CXL Request --> CXL Guarantee denied) Choose an emoji icon to provide specific feedback details and contribute to content improvement.

question: what are the steps to follow if the customer claims that the cancellation guarantee voucher is not working on the payment page

The below feature only appears to ETG users, so don't advise the customer to check it themselves 1) Click on the website link mentioned in Edvin to be automatically redirected to the website where the customer booked the flight. 2) Click on the “Enable” button. This option is available only for the ETG employees. 3) Select the “Tools” field that will appear on the left side. 4) Select “Quick Jumb” 5) Click the box “2 adults” and then select the “ Payment” tab. It may take 1 minute to go to the next page, so you need to wait Even if the number of passengers does not match the ""2 adults"" option, it is recommended to select ""2 adults"" because the page loads faster. 6) Press the “Click here” and then a box will pop up to add the voucher number. * You can find the voucher number in the confirmation email sent to the customer in Edvin. 7) Press “Apply discount voucher”. 8) If the voucher is valid, it turns green. DON’T FORGET to select “remove discount voucher” and then you can go to the home page. You can inform the customer that the voucher is valid and suggest clearing the browser cookies. - Choose the appropriate template in Edvin: FL→ Others→ Verification mail that cancellation guarantee is valid. - Make a register errand by choosing the following: If the voucher does not work, you will receive an error message. As a consequence, you have to place the order to the cancellation guarantee queue informing the support team that the voucher is invalid and they need to issue a new voucher. Make a register errand by choosing the following and inform the customer that he will receive a new voucher.

ground_truth: Wheelchair and Assistance for Sabre Please note that Service-/Support package is not needed for the following requests. Assistance Sabre entry 1) 3WCHR (ramp) Passenger can ascend/descend steps and make own way to/from cabin seat, but requires wheelchair for distance to/from aircraft. We do not need to wait for confirmation. This service is always confirmed. 2) 3WCHS (steps) Passenger is able to walk but unable to ascend or descend stairs 3) 3WCHC (cabin) Passenger is paraplegic/quadriplegic, requires an on-board wheelchair and must be carried to/from cabin seat. Please inform if passenger is self supported on board or what passanger who's gonna assist onboard (if traveling alone, pls inform in what pnr assistant is traveling in) Assistance - more information required Sabre entry - 1) Some airlines demands to know the reason for requesting wheelchair assistance, for the WCHR request it is usually good to add the reason in the request. 2) 3WCHR/elderly problem walking-1.1 Bringing own wheelchair ** Sabre entry - 1) 3WCMP/80x40x60cm 18kg own foldable-1.1 (wheelchair manual power) (Don't need to have it confirmed) 2) 3WCBD/80x40x60cm 18kg own foldable-1.1(wheelchair battery dry / gel battery) 3) 3WCBW/80x40x60cm 18kg own foldable-1.1 (wheelchair battery wet) Note! We never use standard measurements or weight for the passengers own wheelchairs! *For two types of assistance (WCHS and WCHC) the airlines usually wants to know if it is a MEDA or NON MEDA case, before confirming. context: Flexible ticket If the product was purchased during the booking procedure, the Flexible Ticket allows you to change the date and/or time of your flight booking under the terms set out in this section. When providing our Flexible Ticket service, We only mediate the transport contract between You and the relevant airline. As the Flexible Ticket is our own service (i.e. You cannot make use of our Flexible Ticket service by contacting the airline directly) all rebooking requests making use of the Flexible Ticket service must be made via our customer service. Terms and conditions for Flexible Ticket The flexible ticket service allows rebooking of flights, subject to availability. If the amendment involves an upgrade to more expensive tickets, this shall be at the traveller's own expense. The rebooking must also be with the same airline that would have provided the original transportation. Changes made to a Flexible Ticket will only incur a penalty waiver. However, fare and tax differences will still apply. 1.Travelers cannot change the destination, either for the outbound or inbound journey. NOTE: If the customer makes a voluntary change in order to change the destination, the flexible product is no longer available for the new ticket. 2.Travelers cannot change the airport even within the same city. 3.The flexible ticket service does not permit name changes or name corrections. 4.The flights must be used in the order they were originally booked. 5.Upgrades to a different cabin on the same flight are not permitted. 6.Rebooking a ticket for a so-called stop-over is not permitted. 7.Travelers can only rebook the trip once and not per PNR. Once the change is confirmed, the rebooking service has been used and cannot be used again. 8.The flexible ticket can be used at least 24 hours before the original flight. See exception to this rule below.* If the outbound flight is flown, the product is still applicable until 24hrs before the original return flight. 9.In case of a multi PNR, if the customer requests to change the IB flight and the OB flight departs in less than the 24h, we can proceed with the change as the change reflects the PNR of the IB flight. 10.If the customer's type has changed, (child turning into an adult or an infant turning into a child) the traveler must pay the difference that occurred from the new type of code. 11.ETG is not responsible for information about visas if the trip is extended. 12.The new trip may not commence within 24 hours from the time of the change request. ATT: Due to the Covid-19 outbreak, exceptions may apply. For more details click HERE << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/2102661c-4f9f-4afa-88a0-9a4b6c9e2694?parentId=e6a33860-ccb8-4efb-a3f2-2e3bb1fa4c26&view=list-view&trigger=title&searchEventId=01GWVSZ99Q7R9QG50BG8N4EPKM&source=shelf&DTStep=01G62Y94PJ2GZ243B7P4ATNPVN >> 12.When the rebooking is completed, ETG takes no responsibility for any supplementary services such as luggage and seat reservations that have been booked directly with the airline. Follow the rules of the new reissued ticket in case the ticket is exchanged due to flexible ticket and then customer requests cancellation. 13.If a passenger fails to appear for any section of the journey, the rebooking option is no longer valid. 14.The cancellation protection is not valid once the flexible ticket is used as it is connected to the first date of departure. 15.The cancellation guarantee is valid once the flexible ticket is used, even if a new order is created. 16.The flexible ticket service will not be refunded if the trip is cancelled, unless the 24h rule is applicable - see below. 17.If the passenger has a Flexible ticket and is cancelling against the 24h rule, and is eligible for refund, then ensure you run the Modify order by using the option "24h airline rule". Payout agents will refund the ticket and the flexible ticket product. 18.Always rebook the original ticket if possible according to fare rules, even if there is a high difference in price. No discount on high price difference! 19.If the original booking is a OWC or Multi PNR, and both tickets are "changes not permitted" according to the airline rule we still make two separate tickets as the original. 20.Flexible Ticket service is offered per person only to those with a physical seat (infants do not have seat) However, even though Infants do not hold a seat, they will still be included in the service if the adult that the infant is associated with, has purchased the Flexible Ticket. 21.The Flexible Ticket must be booked and paid for during the booking process and cannot be added afterwards NOTE: You can find here how to rebook the ticket via flexible ticket and any exceptions that may apply. 22. Please note that when re-issuance is not possible and a new ticket must be issued, we can offer a different airline to the customer as an exception if it is cheaper. This exception must be pointed out to the customer as the product rules state that rebooking is only with the same airline. Also, you should get the customer's confirmation before issuing a new ticket with a different airline. Search for the cheapest option using Amadeus Master Pricer, offer the customer the cheapest option (all airlines, but do not offer overnight alternatives). 23.In scenarios where we have not been able to provide the Flexible ticket service and we need to refund the extra amount paid (fare difference) or value of the ticket, it is very important that the information in the SL is very clear. We do NOT offer any kind of compensation to the customer if he proceeds with a change directly with the airline. 24.If we will be refunding the penalty or the value of the ticket, use modify order with reason ‘Failed Flex Rebooking’ and also include the connected ancillaries to the ticket (seat, bag). Also add a note as bellow: Please refund the pax change fee XXXXXX or ticket value XXXXXX. 25.If we will be refunding the extra cost paid by the passenger for the rebooking that was not processed successfully, use modify order with reason ‘Ancillary- Voluntary’. *Exception If a customer contacts us in less than 24 hours the following criteria must be met to proceed with the rebooking. - Changes are permitted according to fare rules (If we notice that the airline charge an additional No Show fee then this has to be paid by the customer*) * Examples related to the No Show fee -Many airlines have one fee for changes and a higher one for No show, and according to the fare rules in case of No show, we charge one, the highest. E.g. Changes: 60 EUR No show: 80 EUR Since the highest fee is the No Show fee ( 80 EUR), the amount of 80 EUR will be charged to the customer. -Many other airlines have one fee for changes and one fee for No show, and in case of No show, we charge both. E.g. Changes: 60 EUR No show: 60 EUR In this example, only the No show fee ( 60 EUR) will be charged to the customer, while the remaining 60 EUR (Change fee) will be covered and paid to the airline by us. -There are also other airlines that have one fee for changes and one lesser fee for No show, and in case of No show, we charge both. E.g. Changes: 60 EUR No show: 50 EUR In such cases only the No show fee (50 EUR) will be charged to the customer, while the remaining 60 EUR (Change fee) will be covered and paid to the airline by us. - We are able to rebook and reissue before departure (not in cases of changes not permitted on original ticket) - The new trip may not commence within 24 hours from the time of the change request. Let the customer know this is an exception from our travel terms and condition. No show -If it is possible as per fare rules to rebook after no show, offer this alternative to the customer with all applicable fees. Same with destination changes/open jaws and stopovers – offer this to the customer as per fare rules if possible with all applicable fees. -If the customer chooses to rebook paying all applicable fees due to no-show/destination changes/open jaws/stopover, Flexible Ticket is still valid and can be used later within original terms and conditions. Cancellation A ticket that has been rebooked using the Flexible Ticket is non-refundable to the customer in case of cancellation, regardless of the ticket fare rules. A ticket that has been rebooked using the Flexible Ticket will be refunded according to the standard refund process of voluntary reissued tickets. This means that we need to check the rules of both the original ticket and the new ticket to determine which penalty to charge for the refund. For more information check here. Tax refund, Force Majeure and Schedule Change as exceptions, see below:. Tax Refund Passengers always have the right to claim their taxes on the tickets. question: what does the error message say when working on a pnr with multiple passenger types

While you are updat ing all the fare masks for all passenger types, the error message will st ill appear. Once all fare masks are created, the mask automat ically closes and the fares are stored successfully.

question: how do i correct a misspelled name in farelogix
ground_truth: Name correction policy (for pure LHG flights): Rules for correction of misspelled names: Up to two (2) letters in the first-, middle- or last name or title -> FL agents can proceed directly in Farelogix. Lufthansa Group (LHG) typically recommends following one of two procedures: 1. Create a new PNR for a new ticket and receive a refund for the old ticket. 2. It is essential to consistently adhere to the airline's guidelines. question: how to escalate to sl via edvin
ground_truth: Escalate to SL via Edvin A new way of escalating orders to Backoffice has been created. This process will also replace the current A-list where CR and Communications have been escalating cases to SL. The Edvin tab Refund will display a new button Escalate to BO, through which specific cases will be able to be sent to SL without the use of Etrack contact form (see below screenshot). Important: Do not manually register an errand when escalating this way. In the pop-up window that will appear you will need to: 1) Select the Escalation reason 2) Write the errand text and select the errand Channel/Category/Type/Action 3) After you click the Escalate button it will send the case to SL and will register your errand automatically (so, make sure to write everything that should be mentioned) - see the below screenshot. ***Attention*** If you need to escalate more than one PNR in the same order, please make sure to select the respective label for each PNR. For example, if you have two PNRs that need to be escalated with the same label, you will escalate the first PNR and then you will escalate the second PNR as well. You can confirm the escalation has been done successfully by checking that the errand has been registered and the label has been applied (see below screenshot) The label categories ( each category has labels that we can choose from) that we are allowed to escalate thisway can be found below: Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED When to use - FLX EMD ONLY for Farelogix bookings. Refundapplication needs to be sent by SL viaBSP link for the EMD. Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - NDC - RA in BSP When to use - To be used when the airline hasinformed that refund application needsto be sent through BSP link for all NDCportals: FLX: LHG, AA, A3/OA, BA/IB,AF/KL Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - Handled by FL/SC When to use - Only for cases that were escalated backto FL/SC by SL. FL/SC agents will markorder with this label once they completethe actions, and now FL/SC needs toescalate back to SL for further actions. Note: When the case is handled by FL andno refund should be processed to thecustomer in the end, the FL Support agentshould not remove the case from the“Manual -Handle Refund Case queue”, butescalate the case back to BO via the label“Handled by FL/SC” stating that the caseshould be removed from the refunddashboard. Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - FL/SC - Awaiting pax When to use - This is to be used by support agents.When SL will escalate back a case toFL/SC and FL/SC will inform pax withalternative options should ALWAYSinsert this label. If the customer will notrevert SL will use this label to removethe case from the Refund Dashboard. Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - FL/SC - Awaiting Splr When to use - This is to be used by support agents.When SL will escalate back a case toFL/SC and FL/SC will contact thesupplier (for authorization, exceptionalrequest, clarifi cations, etc) shouldALWAYS insert this label. This is in orderfor SL to be aware that this case ispending supplier's response and notremove the case from the RefundDashboard. Group Title - FL ESC - UNCLAIMED Label Title - QR EMD - done - NOT to be used byFL/SC When to use - NOT to be used by FL/SC - This is to be used only by CT team Group Title - FL ESC - REFUND RECEIVED Label Title - Ref. rec. 10 days When to use - For any order for which we havereceived money from the airline and notrefunded to the customer within 10days. In cases, where the above requirementsapply but the case is not on the RefundDashboard, you should use Modifyorder and then escalate with this label. Group Title - FL ESC - REFUND RECEIVED Label Title - ACM received - NOT to be used byFL/SC When to use - NOT to be used by FL/SC - CT hasaccounted for an ACM in Antares andthe order is ready for payout Group Title - FL ESC - REFUND RECEIVED Label Title - Tech error - CXL G - NOT to be used byFL/SC When to use - NOT to be used by FL/Sc - No refund tothe customer. Antares handling only. Group Title - FL ESC - DEADLINE BY AIRLINE Label Title - NACO When to use - When SL needs to refund a ticket due toNACO. (For example NACO with AZ). Group Title - FL ESC - DEADLINE BY AIRLINE Label Title - YY auth When to use - The airline has given usauthorisation for a limited time (forexample LH waiver code valid for 48hours) Group Title - FL ESC - DEADLINE BY AIRLINE Label Title - Ref before departure When to use - The claim of the ticket should be donebefore the departure date. Group Title - FL ESC - DEADLINE BY AIRLINE Label Title - Expiring within 72hr When to use - 1. To be added by Frontline for ticketsexpiring within 72 hours. 2. For NH domestic PNRs ONLY afterusing the modify order. Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - Customer Relations - NOT to be usedby FL/SC When to use - NOT to be used by FL/SC - For casesescalated by the Customer Relationsteam. 12hr SLA Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - TL Escalations When to use - For priority ONLY if TL has insertedauthorisation note in Edvin. Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - ETG Escalations When to use - Label added by FL/SC agents handlingETG Escalation task. 48hr SLA Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - CR payout done - NOT to be used byFL/SC When to use - NOT to be used by FL/SC- CR paysout in advance. This label will beblocked from automated payouts Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - TL - Pend/Rej RA When to use - To be used only by TL/Manager/FLCoordinator for Rejected or Pending RA Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - Old cancellation fee When to use - For cases where we have informed thecustomer about cancellation with theold fee (pax did not accept cancellationthat time) and once customer calledback to confi rm and we informed aboutthe new fee he/she made a complaintand we want to apply the old fee. Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - B.com calculator discrepancy When to use - For B.com cases where FL agent hasidentifi ed the discrepancy between totalrefundable amount displayed in B.com My Bookings portal and actualrefundable amount stated by YY farerules. Group Title - FL ESC - ETG Escalations Label Title - Dupe tripstack AA When to use - To be used for all American Airlinesbookings through Tripstack, where wehave canceled the order due to dupe. All the details can be found here << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/4e8b8ab8-22c6-4b5c-8023-c5fbd44f0dcc?parentId=2645607d-c6cc-4603-9764-5af778dc9ad2&view=card-view&trigger=double-click&searchEventId=01G8JHN0ZR7EKH7X6X4HZ3FHCC&source=shelf&DTStep=uCtQo6K3CJ >> Please keep in mind that only cases that are already canceled and still active in the Refund dashboard are able to be escalated this way, and only for the abovementioned reasons. For orders that have already been refunded to the passenger (payout done), not yet canceled, or belong to any other category than the above, the old way of escalation will need to be used as per below. 3) Continue using Modify order for the following: 24h airline rule Force Majeure - refund Schedule Change - refund Tech error - ticket Ticket rules - airline fee (to be used also for non-urgent authorization provided from the airline company) Ticket rules - taxes Void FL/SC agents are able to view eNett transactions under the VAN tab in Edvin. This way, whenever applicable, the agent is able to confirm if a refund has been indeed processed in case of a customer claiming this. Meaning that such cases should not be sent to SL at all In addition, we have to be more strict with the volume of orders sent for check of the refund status. All of us are aware of the fact that airline companies are also dealing with huge backlogs and authorizations for refunds are delayed. As a consequence, a lot of customers are coming to us asking for additional information, time frames, deadlines, etc. Escalating the case to SL will not quicken the process, so you should always be thinking critically and place the order for a Refund status checks only if: 1) the customer knows the airline company has refunded us for his order already 2) medical/death cases when at least 7 days have passed after CR approving the document (applicable when the customer has Cancellation protection, currently approximately 2-weeks time frame for CR to handle) and there are no notes from SL in Edvin. *IMPORTANT - If there are no errands from CR, FL agents are to first check with their TL or Supervisor whether the docs were received by us BEFORE reaching out to the CR team.

question: what is considered as urgent request
ground_truth: A case shall be escalated to the Urgent Support queue when meets the below requirements: 1) Original Departure/Return date is within 3 working days. 2) For rebooking, the New Departure/Return date is within 3 working days. 3) For rebooking, same day or before ticket issued. 4) For cancellation against 24 hour rule/void that needs to be escalated. 5) The ticket validity will expire within 3 working days. 6) Other specific deadline provided by airline that will expire within 3 working days. (ex. authorisation valid for short period etc) 7) The case is already on normal support queue, and the customer calls back to follow up the same request for the 3rd time.

question: when to use moto payment
ground_truth: Content - Payment methods for post-sale services What is a MOTO payment and when to use? When to use? MOTO is a preferred method of payment for all products and services as well as for collecting our handling fees.MOTO should always be suggested as the first payment option during phone interactions unless it is not technically supported.(The MOTO Payment button will not be available in Edvin when creating an Add on cart for orders, where the MOTO form of payment is not technically supported). MOTO Payment is NOT supported for LATAM markets.It will not be available as a payment option in the Add on cart in Edvin for these markets. All cards are supported for payments via MOTO, except Maestro cards, which will NOT be accepted on AU on the CA market. Booking.com orders are no more excluded from the MOTO Payment option. For markets, where MOTO is enabled, you shall always first suggest MOTO Payment as available payment method also on Booking.com orders. Note that MOTO payment will not be technically possible when active monitoring is in place (such as Supervisor monitoring or other agent shadowing). ATT: Never send the customer to secure payment flow via Genesys, if MOTO Payment is not available as an option in Add on cart!Genesys is not able to differentiate the markets, for which MOTO payment is not supported. Of course, for all requests, if the customer is not able to fulfill the payment on the spot, during the initial phone call or denies processing via MOTO, youmay still offer a Payment link as per standard routines. ATT: Whenever youoffer a Payment link, youshall state in your errand the reason why youcould not use MOTO (i.e:pax denied MOTO, MOTO not enabled etc.). Support agents should also use the MOTO Payment as a preferred method of fulfilling the charges during their outgoing phone interactions.For details on How to make an outbound call, please refer to the relevant section here.Please note that the option to send the customer to IVR flow will be available only if the call is performed on behalf of a relevant queue. Schedule change requests shall be handled as per separate guidelines.For more detailed information check 4) Schedule change handling page in this decision tree. REMINDER: Always respect the deadline required for handling by other departments, as per standard routines: - For rebooking cases, the reissue request must be placed on the respective queue at least 4 hours before the original departure and/or at least 6 hours before the new flight. Otherwise, changes are not possible. - For ancillary requests, the request can be handled up to 48h prior to the departure. - For all other services, the request can be handled up to 24h prior to the departure.

A direct payment form, which allows the customer to pay the additional charges via a secure IVR payment flow, during the phone call handled via Genesys. The agent is not handling any sensitive data, all the card details are inserted by the customer during the IVR payment flow. The outcome of the payment is shown to the agent in real time. When to use? MOTO is a preferred method of payment for all products and services as well as for collecting our handling fees. MOTO should always be suggested as the first payment option during phone interactions unless it is not technically supported. (The MOTO Payment button will not be available in Edvin when creating an Add on cart for orders, where the MOTO form of payment is not technically supported). MOTO Payment is NOT supported for LATAM markets. It will not be available as a payment option in the Add on cart in Edvin for these markets. All cards are supported for payments via MOTO, except Maestro cards, which will NOT be accepted on AU on the CA market. Booking.com orders are no more excluded from the MOTO Payment option. For markets, where MOTO is enabled, you shall always first suggest MOTO Payment as available payment method also on Booking.com orders. Note that MOTO payment will not be technically possible when active monitoring is in place (such as Supervisor monitoring or other agent shadowing). ATT: Never send the customer to secure payment flow via Genesys, if MOTO Payment is not available as an option in Add on cart!Genesys is not able to differentiate the markets, for which MOTO payment is not supported. Of course, for all requests, if the customer is not able to fulfill the payment on the spot, during the initial phone call or denies processing via MOTO, you may still offer a Payment link as per standard routines. ATT: Whenever you offer a Payment link, you shall state in your errand the reason why you could not use MOTO (i.e: pax denied MOTO, MOTO not enabled etc.). Support agents should also use the MOTO Payment as a preferred method of fulfilling the charges during their outgoing phone interactions. For details on How to make an outbound call, please refer to the relevant section here. Please note that the option to send the customer to IVR flow will be available only if the call is performed on behalf of a relevant queue. For rebooking cases, the reissue request must be placed on the respective queue at least 4 hours before the original departure and/or at least 6 hours before the new flight. question: how to correctly perform an outbound call
ground_truth: Outbound Call - General process How to correctly perform an outbound call? Remember always to start a new outgoing interaction on behalf of the respective queue is presented in the below steps. Only in this way, the number that will be presented to the customer will be the one connected to the chosen queue and therefore relevant to the respective market. Choose interaction option from the left-hand menu: 2. Press on the ‘+’ icon to start a new interaction: 3. Fill in the pop-up window by selecting a correct queue, depending on the market, where the booking was created: ATT: Please note that you are able to choose only between the queues, for which you are set as active. 4. Add the number which you want to call and press ENTER. You have to press the enter button in order for the phone icon to turn green. Only then you will be able to press the phone icon and perform a call on behalf of the queue. question: where to find and how to use the ghost line keys
ground_truth: Ghost line keys in Amadeus and Sabre Where to find and how to use the ghost line keys in Amadeus and Sabre Qbay reads and priorities bookings based on time and date in HK/GK/YK segments. AMADEUS Under the SUPP-key, option 1: No 1: When you want to give the pnr top urgent prioritizing in Qbay. Always select this when sending for involuntary reissue Schedule Change. Also use this option for urgent departure within 72hrs for Schedule Change support. Can also be used for urgent voluntary reissue, when stated in Documents that urgent reissue is needed. No 2: If the passenger wants to travel earlier than the original date, use this option to insert a ghost segment for the new requested date. No 1: The smartkey will ask you for the destination and number of passengers. question: how to do call transfer or callback errand
ground_truth: Call Transfer or Callback Errand A new type of errand has been created for call transfers and callback requests to Supervisors on duty, Team Leaders, and Managers. Each time a customer requests their call to be transferred to a Supervisor on duty, Team leader, or Manager, we now have the new errand Type "Call transfer/Callback (SOD/TL/Manager)" and errand Action "Pax requested call transfer/callback" that has been added under the relevant categories. Thus, we keep the Channel and Category as we would originally register them, and use the new Type and Action. Example errand - a customer that has requested to speak with the Supervisor on duty about the cancellation: 1: Phone In 2: Cancellation / refund 4: Call transfer/Callback (SOD/TL/Manager) 1: Pax requested call transfer/callback The categories this has been added under are the following: 1: Rebooking 2: Cancellation / refund 3: Claim wrong itinerary/name/dupe 4: Change of name & passenger info 5: Document & travel info 6: Payment questions 7: Baggage 8: Seating 9: Other services/products 10: Force Majeure 13: Language problem 18: Schedule change 23: Claim CR 24: Accommodation 25: Other Booking.com<< http://booking.com/ >> products 26: Booking.com<< http://booking.com/ >> phase 1 - No order in Edvin 36: ETG Escalation

question: how to handle cases escalated by bo refunds team
ground_truth: How to handle cases escalated by BO Refunds team When BO will escalate a case back to FL for further handling with the customer, the support team will send an email to the customer with the alternative options and will ask him to call back within 5 days in order to confirm which option he prefers. In all these cases the support will also use a label for escalation to BO called ""FL-Awaiting pax"" and then will remove the case from Support queue. Once the customer will call back to confirm the options, please handle as below based on the scenario: Scenario - Customer confirms open ticket How to handle 1. Send a confirmation email to the customer through Edvin for open ticket. 2. Change order (if applicable). 3. If the order contains more than one PNRs that are canceled but not all of them were escalated back to FL, escalate it to SL using the label ""Handled by FL/SC"" and request to close the case for the specific PNR. 4. If it is a single PNR remove the case from the Refund dashboard. Scenario - Customer confirms Voucher How to handle 1. Voucher should be issued by ETG 1.1 Register errand with ticketing template 1.2 Place the order on BOM TKT. 1.3 Send confirmation through Edvin for voucher. Change order (if applicable). 1.4 If the order contains more than one PNRs that are canceled but not all of them were escalated back to FL, escalate it to SL using the label ""Handled by FL/SC"" and request to close the case for the specific PNR. 1.5 If it is a single PNR remove the case from the Refund dashboard. 2 Voucher should be issued by Airline. 2.1 Place the order on FL urgent support of your location. 2.2 Register errand. 2.3 If the order contains more than one PNRs that are canceled but not all of them were escalated back to FL, escalate it to SL using the label ""Handled by FL/SC"" and request to close the case for the specific PNR. 2.4 If it is a single PNR remove the case from the Refund dashboard. Scenario - Customer confirms refund according to fare rules How to handle 1. Escalate to BO using the label ""Handled by FL"" and register errand at the same time. 2. Send a confirmation email to the customer. Scenario - Customer does not confirm any option. How to handle 1. Inform the customer that no further action will be taken on his booking. Case is considered as closed. 2. Register errand. **In case the customer calls back within the given deadline (of 5 days) asking for clarifications, you may provide him with the requested details and with a deadline of 3 days to think about what option he/she prefers and call us back for confirmation.

question: what to do if customers calling due to a possible fraud attempt
ground_truth: External Source Call Types 1. Journalists calling our Customer Support line 1.1. Under no circumstances should our agents disclose any information to a journalist who contacts us. 1.2. If we do receive requests from journalists, they should be directed to Press Contact - Etraveli Group<< https://www.etraveligroup.com/press-contact/ >>. 2. Customers calling due to a possible fraud attempt 2.1. We have received some calls from customers informing that people claiming to work at Mytrip, Supersavertravel etc are asking to share their bank and credit card details to be able to provide refund of their booking. 2.2. If you received such calls please make sure to take information and share through the following way and inform the customer that we will review this and take further action if needed; ETG In-house: Please provide feedback in this Google sheet with information about order number, name of the person you speak to, phone number where we can reach the customer and a short description on what has been asked for. This text is shown on all our sites now. “Warning! People claiming to work at Etraveli Group have been calling our customers asking them to share their bank and credit card details under the pretext that they need these details to refund the customer. If any lawyer requires information regarding the address for serving legal documents, kindly refer them to our website, as the company’s address is stated at the bottom of the main webpage. If a letter from a lawyer is received where the airline has been sued (not ETG), and they need assistance, this is to be forwarded to airlines.nordic@support.etraveli.com. You may provide this email address and ask them to send an email.

question: how to handle agent callback process when the line drops
ground_truth: Agent Callback Process when the line drops Below you may find the process in case the line drops: 1. Change your status in Genesys to Busy -> 'Other ops task’ 2. Try to reach the passenger on the same phone number. You can find it in the Call history in Genesys (if the call was from a private number, call the number registered in Edvin). You need to try and call the customer once. ALWAYS follow the outbound call process here << https://etraveligroup.shelf.io/read/d5aa2b33-b663-4c2a-8a8b-34cc5aeba0c7/?parentId=9bb104[%E2%80%A6]3V1BCT9GBQ&source=shelf&DTStep=01FVYR1YPV97BJE904R1SEZ0G9#first-opened-step >>. For all outbound calls FL/SC agents make to a customer, the settled minimum waiting time for the customer to pick up the call is 40 seconds, before the agent disconnects the ph 2.1 If the passenger is reached and assisted -> Register errand using channel Phone In and the respective request category (ex: if rebooking - select rebooking ). Always include the interaction id in the errand and the number you reached the passenger if differs from the one in Edvin. 2.2 If the customer is not reached and the request has not been communicated before the call dropped-> Send an email using the Edvin template “Agent callback when call disconnected”. Always include the interaction id in the errand and the number you tried to reach the passenger if differs from the one in Edvin. and Register Errand with: Channel: Phone in Category: Call disconnected Type: Customer not reached Action: E-mail sent 2.3 If the customer is not reached but the request has been communicated before the call dropped, FCR needs to be followed-> Send an email using the Edvin template “Agent callback when call disconnected” and amend the template according to the procedure/advise/action taken towards the customer's request. Always include the interaction id in the errand and the number you tried to reach then passenger if differs from the one in Edvin. Register Errand with : Channel: Phone in Category: Call disconnected Type: Customer not reached Action: E-mail sent Important Note: The agents are expected to always follow the FCR in every process which ends when the agents communicate the actions taken towards the customer's request. Therefore, when applicable, the standard template “Agent callback when call disconnected” needs to be amended. The customer shall not be motivated/encouraged to contact us again when not really necessary. Whenever performing a call back process, always start a new outgoing interaction on behalf of the queue respective for the market, where the order was created. For more details on how to initiate the interaction correctly, refer to chapter Outbound call. Then you add the number you want to call, press enter. The phone icon will turn green and you will perform a call on behalf of the queue. The number that will be presented to the customer will be the one connected to the chosen queue. ATT: Only when starting a new outgoing interaction on behalf of a respective queue the secure IVR MOTO payment feature will be accessible in Genesys. Do NOT call back the customer via Call History, as in case of the need to perform the MOTO Payment, you will not be able to send the customer to IVR MOTO payment flow. There is a template for the 'Agent callback when call disconnected' process which can be found under the Others-FL option: Technical line issues during the call/no response from customer's end If you experience technical line issues during the call, you are allowed to disconnect the on-going interaction, provided all the below steps are followed: 1. You have to ensure twice that the communication is disturbed by technical issues. 1.1 You shall ask twice if the customer can hear you well and receive no positive response 2. You have to inform the customer that due to the technical line issues, you will disconnect the call and straightforward call back the customer on the same contact number. 2.1 Ensure that the contact number can be retrieved. If the customer is calling from a private unknown number, ensure that you have access to the order and inform the customer that you will contact him/her back on the contact number provided in the booking. 3. You have to perform the call back immediately and regardless of the number of awaiting calls in the queue, as per the steps described at the beginning of this article. For the cases where the customer's number is private and no order id can be retrieved (no callback is possible) then register errand with: Channel: Phone in Category: Call disconnected Type: No phone number available Action: No order retrieved FAQ's 1. Do we need to call back when the call drops before even talking to the customer or understand what he/she needs? Yes, when the number is retrievable by the Genesys History. 2. Is there a need for the process to be followed regardless of the number of calls waiting in the queue? Regardless of the volumes, we need to follow the process to call back if the call is involuntarily disconnected. 3. Are we allowed to disconnect the call if we experience technical line issues, which makes it impossible to communicate with the customer? Yes, but you have to inform the customer that due to the technical line issues, you will disconnect the call and straightforward call back the customer on the same contact number. The callback process is mandatory and has to be performed regardless of the number of waiting calls. number. question: how to rebook when passenger not shown
ground_truth: Rebook when passenger is a no-show No-Show 1) If coupon status is still open: 1.1) Check the PNR history to make sure that the passenger was indeed a no-show. 1.2) Always try ATC/WFRF. If it works, you can trust it. You do not need to check the rules if it works (exception TK). 1.3) If it doesn't work, check the rules of the ticket. If no information about no-show in the rules appears it is not permitted to change the ticket, exceptions do apply. 1.4) Check, in Edvin Docs to see, if any exceptions apply for that airline. 2) If the PNR is expired in the GDS: If the ghost-line has expired or never been inserted, the PNR will expire and you will be unable to retrieve it. 2.1) Display the old ticket by using the ticket number. (TWD/TKTxxx-xxxxxxxxxx / WETR*Txxxxxxxxxx // xxx=ticket number). 2.2) Create a new PNR with the same airline as per fare rules. 2.3) Insert the old ticket number on FHE line. In Amadeus, if there are more than 1 passengers make sure to indicate to which passenger the ticket number belongs to (FHEtkt nr/P1) 2.4) Try ATC. If it works, it is ok. If not, calculate manually, calculate the difference in fare and taxes, and include the change fee and no-show fee also add our rebooking service fee. 2.5) If the customer pays, save the new flights and the mandatory elements in the GDS, link the new PNR in Edvin (ALWAYS use the correct OID/ PCC) and run rebooking wizard to send to ticketing, inserting all the relevant information for the scenario you handle. 3) If the status on the ticket is S (Suspended) 3.1) Make sure that changes are permitted and status can be reopened as per the airline's rules. 3.2) Calculate manually on the change, applying any normal penalty and no- show, if both are to be charged. 3.3) Inform the passenger the minimum fee (penalty+ our rebooking service fee) to make sure they still want to proceed. If passengers agree, send them the payment link and advise that any extra cost for the fare difference has to be covered by them, once the ticket status is open. Make sure you write all calculating information as a manual calculation, including new flights. If the passenger does not want to change, no action. 3.4) The support agent will pick up the case and contact the airline to open the ticket.Support team: Ask the airline to open the ticket due to rebooking after no-show. Make sure that whether there is time restriction on how long the ticket status will remain open (ex. HR, they leave the ticket open only for 24 hours). 3.5) When the ticket is open, the Support team will make ATC if possible, otherwise, rebook and copy the manual calculation and send for reissue. The outbound is no-show, and the passenger wants to change the inbound or make it to an OW: NOT possible if the original coupons are status OPEN, even if ATC / WFRF works. When making a reissue, the system reissues all open coupons from the top to bottom (in the sequence they have been issued). It is not possible to choose what coupons to reissue, hence it will try to reissue also the outbound, but, since it is the inbound we want to change, it is not possible. Some airlines though (e.g LHG) have a procedure for turning an RT ticket into an OW. It's not a normal rebooking, it's an exceptional procedure. Check, in Edvin if there is such an option mentioned. If yes, charge inform the passenger about potential additional charges and the support agent will contact the airline.
